old_text: A feared insured event has occurred and the entitled claimant is aware of the event and the insurance claim.
quotation: Ist das befürchtete Ereignis eingetreten, so muss der Anspruchsberechtigte, sobald er von diesem Ereignisse und seinem Anspruche aus der Versicherung Kenntnis erlangt, das Versicherungsunternehmen benachrichtigen.
reasoning: Every claim presupposes an occurred insured event known to the claimant, and the passages (also 0100 'über alle Schadenereignisse') make notice to the insurer (D01 or D02) due in every case.

old_text: The loss is connected with theft, attempted theft, robbery, or a theft incident requiring investigation.
quotation: Bei allen Schäden im Zusammenhang mit Diebstahl oder dem Versuch dazu ist unverzüglich bei der örtlichen Polizei Anzeige zu erstatten.
reasoning: Theft or attempted theft is what the case type is; the passages ('Bei Diebstahl hat der Versicherungsnehmer ferner' 0028, 'Bei Diebstahl oder Beraubung hat er zusätzlich' 0103, AXA 0168) make police notification and the request for an investigation due in every theft case.

old_text: Crime-scene traces exist or alterations at the loss location or to damaged property are contemplated before loss determination.
new_text: Before the loss was determined, crime-scene traces were removed or altered, or the loss location or the damaged items were altered, repaired or disposed of, or help services were engaged on the damaged items, or such a change is planned; traces or damaged items that exist but were left unchanged do not count.
quotation: ohne Zustimmung der Polizei die Tatspuren nicht zu entfernen oder zu verändern
reasoning: The consents the rule demands (D26, D27) concern a change: the passages forbid removing or altering traces (0043, 0127), altering the loss location or damaged item (0033), altering or disposing of damaged items (0136, 0148, 0156) or using help services (0096) without consent, so the mere existence of traces does not make a consent due.

quotation: Der Anspruchsberechtigte ist verpflichtet, nach Eintritt des befürchteten Ereignisses tunlichst für Minderung des Schadens zu sorgen.
reasoning: 'After the event' holds in every claim and the mitigation, preservation and (0056, 0099) perpetrator-identification and recovery duties of fact f01 apply after every theft; f01 has no document route. Fact f02 was split off to overlay_rule_004.a (see next row).

new_text: After the event, measures were to be taken to reduce the loss or to preserve or rescue insured items and there was no imminent danger preventing the claimant from first obtaining the insurer's instruction, or the insurer gave instructions (Weisung / Anordnung) on measures to be taken; the occurrence of the event alone does not count.
quotation: Er muss, wenn nicht Gefahr im Verzug liegt, über die zu ergreifenden Massnahmen die Weisung des Versicherungsunternehmens einholen und befolgen.
reasoning: The insurer's instruction (D25) is tied to 'die zu ergreifenden Massnahmen' and excused under 'Gefahr im Verzug' (VVG), and CSS 0170 / Simpego 0100 require following instructions given ('die Anordnungen der CSS zu befolgen'), so fact f02 is due only where measures were to be taken or instructions were given; f02 moved to new rule overlay_rule_004.a with a new condition (guard_id null, as for overlay_rule_020.a).
